description: GET the URL (robots-respecting, public hosts only) and report status, final URL after redirects, content type, title, declared languages and whether a contact page is linked. Use before a bulk job or to clean a URL list. Example: url 'example.com'. Response: result with emails[] (email, source, role), phones[] (e164, international, region, type, source), whatsapp[], social{platform: [url, handle]}, addresses[], organization{}, pages[] (what was fetched, status) and summary{}, plus data_confidence, estimated_items[], sources[], data_version, warnings[] and a disclaimer. Charged per page actually fetched; failed fetches are free. URLs are not logged.
name: check_url
title: Check that a website is reachable
